info.title: Booking Engine API (booking flow subset)
info.description:
This API allows 3rd parties to become a sales channel for GuestPoint.

Only endpoints available to 3rd-party channels are documented here. Every request must be authenticated with the `X-API-KEY` header (a partner backend key or a session key generated from it).

All property-scoped endpoints live under `/properties/{propertyId}/...`, where `propertyId` is the GuestPoint property id.

### Response envelope
Successful responses are wrapped:
```json
{ "success": true, "data": { ... }, "traceId": "01HAM2Z9R2..." }
```
Errors are returned as:
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "Human readable reason" }
```
Some validation errors return a list instead:
```json
{ "success": false, "messages": ["reason one", "reason two"] }
```

### Value formats
- Monetary amounts are returned as **strings** (e.g. `"337.5"`) to preserve
  decimal precision.
- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` strings; timestamps are RFC3339 strings. - Rates are in the currency of the Property. Use the Exchange Rate endpoint
  to convert for display.

get.description:
Get Room, Availability and Rate data for the given query parameters.

This returns enough information to complete a booking:
 - Property information, images and messages to display
 - Room Type information and images, availability for the selected dates,
   and any urgency messaging
 - Rate Plan information and nightly rates for the selected dates,
   including a strike-through rate (the rate prior to any promo discount)
   where appropriate
 - Policy information for each rate plan


Normally, if a room type has no availability for one of the nights, or a rate is closed or otherwise unsuitable due to restrictions, that room type or rate is omitted, so **only sellable data is returned**.

If `calendarMode=true` is supplied, unsellable data is also returned and the client must handle it (for example, a calendar showing unsellable dates).
Rates are returned in the currency of the Property. Use the Get Exchange Rate endpoint to get an exchange rate to apply when displaying rates in the local currency.
Images may be omitted if they are of no interest.
An array of properties is returned to support future functionality, even though a single property is currently returned.

parameters.name: departureDate
parameters.description: Date of departure (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after arrivalDate.

parameters.name: numAdults
parameters.description: Number of adults. Must be greater than 0.

parameters.name: calendarMode
parameters.description: Include dates with no availability or closed rates.

parameters.name: roomTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of room-type external ids to filter to.

parameters.name: ratePlans
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of rate-plan external ids to filter to.

parameters.name: propertyGroupId
parameters.description: Property group id. Only required when calling the group-scoped variant of this endpoint without a propertyId.

get.description: Returns the best available rate per day across a date range, suitable for driving calendar widgets. Each property entry contains a `Days` map keyed by date.

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End of the range (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be after fromDate; maximum range is 365 nights.

parameters.name: roomType
parameters.description: Restrict to a single room-type external id.

get.description: Check whether a promo code is valid for the property. Returns an array of matching promotions (a single code may resolve to more than one applicable promotion).

post.description: Returns the extras (add-ons) that are eligible for the supplied room stays. Called for the guest-details step after room stays have been selected.

Example 1.description: Only the dates, room type and rate plan of each room stay are needed to work out which extras are on offer.

Example 1.summary: Three of the extras on offer
Example 1.description: Send the ones the booker chooses back on the room stay as `Extras`, using the `Id` here and one `Counts` entry per price. A `perRoom`, `perNight` or `perBooking` extra has a single unnamed price, so it takes a single count.

get.description:
Get the profile fields the property collects in addition to the standard guest details. Use these to build your booking form, then send the answers back as `ProfileFields` - on a guest for a `person`, `company` or `both` field, and on the reservation for a `reservation` field.

For a `lookup` field the booker must choose one of the supplied `Values`, and it is that value's `ExternalId` that is sent back.

parameters.name: includeInactive
parameters.description: Include fields that are no longer in use. Off by default.

patch.description:
Validate the provided reservation to check that it can be created. If availability and restrictions are met, prices are recalculated and the validated reservation is returned, including a `VerificationCode` and payment details.

The prices calculated here should be displayed to the booker and used for payment. Any prices sent by the client are ignored when saving a booking.

Booked by one of the guests.summary: One room, one guest, no separate booking contact
Booked by one of the guests.description: `BookingContact` is omitted, so the first guest is used as the booking contact. Every guest carries an `ID`, and the room stay points at it with `GuestId`.

ProfileFields.Name: How did you hear about us

Booked by one of the guests.summary: Response to the request example above
Booked by one of the guests.description: Prices have been recalculated and a `ConfNum` and `VerificationCode` generated, both of which must be sent to Create Reservation. `BookingContact` has been filled in from the first guest.

RoomStays.PolicyText: No deposit is required at time of booking. The remaining balance is to be paid on Arrival. Free cancellation up to 3 days before arrival.

ProfileFields.Name: How did you hear about us

post.description: Create a reservation for your channel. When verification is enabled, the `VerificationCode` returned by Validate Reservation must be supplied and must match the `ConfNum`, otherwise the reservation is rejected as expired.

Booked by an agent.summary: The same booking, with a separate booking contact
Booked by an agent.description: The `ConfNum` and `VerificationCode` returned by Validate Reservation are sent back unchanged. The booking was made by someone who is not staying, so `BookingContact` is supplied with its own `ID` - required here because the guests have ids.

Booked by an agent.summary: Response to the request example above
Booked by an agent.description: The saved reservation. `ID` is now set, and `BookingContact` is the agent rather than the guest. No `VerificationCode` is returned, as it has been consumed.

RoomStays.PolicyText: No deposit is required at time of booking. The remaining balance is to be paid on Arrival. Free cancellation up to 3 days before arrival.

Captions.description: Map of language code to caption.

CancelTime.description: Omitted if the reservation has not been cancelled.

ModifyTime.description: Omitted if the reservation has not been modified.

BookingContact.description: The person who made the booking, echoed back with any generated ids. Falls back to the first guest when the request did not supply one. Null if the reservation has no booking contact recorded.

RatePlanId.description: Required on input; not returned on output.

GuestId.description: Matches an id in the reservation's Guests array. If omitted, the guest in the same position in that array is used.

ExternalId.description: Send this as the `Value` of the answer.

Value.description: The text to display to the booker.

BookingEngineProfileField.title: BookingEngineProfileField
BookingEngineProfileField.description: The definition of an additional field the property collects. Retrieved from Get Profile Fields; answers are sent back as `ReservationProfileField`.

ExternalId.description: Send this as the `Id` of the answer.

GroupName.description: Used to group related fields together for display.

FieldType.description: Determines what the answer may contain.

FieldScope.description: Where the answer belongs. `person`, `company` and `both` are asked of a guest and returned in that guest's `ProfileFields`; `reservation` is asked once and returned in the reservation's `ProfileFields`.

Values.description: The options to choose from. Only set for a `lookup` field.

Sequence.description: The order in which to display the fields.

BeddingConfig.title: BeddingConfig
BeddingConfig.description: Bed counts. Each field is null when that bed type is not present.

RoomTypeId.description: Only present when the roomType query parameter is supplied.

RoomTypeName.description: Only present when the roomType query parameter is supplied.

ReservationRoomStayRate.title: ReservationRoomStayRate
ReservationRoomStayRate.description: Server-generated pricing detail; not required on input.

Facilities.description: Map of facility category to a list of facility names.

ID.description: A unique id for this guest within the booking, used by `ReservationRoomStay.GuestId`. Should always be supplied. If it is omitted, the guest's position in the Guests array is used instead ("1" for the first guest), in which case ids must be omitted for every guest and for the booking contact.

ReservationProfileField.title: ReservationProfileField
ReservationProfileField.description: An answer to one of the property's profile fields.

Id.description: The `ExternalId` of the profile field being answered.

Type.description: The `FieldType` of the profile field being answered.

Value.description: For a `lookup` field this is the `ExternalId` of the chosen `ProfileFieldValue`, otherwise the answer itself.

messages.description: Present instead of `message` for multi-error validation failures.

ReservationInput.title: ReservationInput
ReservationInput.description: Reservation payload for Validate and Create. Pricing fields (`ReservationTotal`, rate details, discounts) are recalculated server-side; supplied values are ignored for pricing.

VerificationCode.description: Returned by Validate Reservation; required by Create when verification is enabled.

BookingContact.description: The person who made the booking. Only needed when they are not one of the guests; if omitted, the first guest is used. An `ID` must be supplied when the guests have ids, otherwise it is generated as the number of room stays plus one.

ExtraType.description: Only `checkout` extras are offered at present.

CheckoutType.description: `quantity` lets the booker choose how many; `service` is taken once or not at all.

MaxItems.description: The most that can be taken. 0 means no limit.

PriceType.description: How the `Prices` are applied when totalling. `perPerson` and `perPersonPerNight` use the per-guest-type prices; the others use the single unnamed price.

ReservationPaymentCard.title: ReservationPaymentCard
ReservationPaymentCard.description: Card details. On output only the non-sensitive fields (CardHolderName, CardNumberMask, CardExpiry, CardType) are returned, and only for the booking engine channel.
